profile_text.body:
StackBlitz is the company behind Bolt.new, an AI-powered builder that the site describes as a tool for creating websites, apps, and prototypes using natural language input. The site positions Bolt.new as a platform that routes tasks automatically to the appropriate AI model, balancing quality and cost, with the stated goal of removing the need for users to manage multiple platforms or select AI agents manually.

Bolt.new is tracked on theworldofai.org under the Coding and Developer Tools category, with a focus on app generation. Beyond this product listing, no litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for StackBlitz.
